subject: eng
title: Adverbs of frequency: always, usually, often, sometimes, never
goal: Ти навчишся вживати слова always, usually, often, sometimes, never, щоб розповісти, як часто ти щось робиш.

theory.text: Минулого уроку ти розповідав про свій розпорядок дня. Сьогодні додаси нові слова, які показують, ЯК ЧАСТО ти щось робиш: always, usually, often, sometimes, never.

items.ex: I always get up at seven o'clock.
I usually have breakfast at eight.
I often play football after school.
I sometimes watch TV in the evening.
I never go to bed after ten o'clock.
I brush my teeth every day.
I wash my face every morning.
I play with my friends at the weekend.

theory.title: Порядок слів
theory.text: Прислівники частотності стоять **перед основним дієсловом**: I **always** get up at seven. I **usually** have breakfast at eight. Шкала частоти: always (100%) → usually → often → sometimes → never (0%).

theory.title: Шкала частоти
head: Слово
Частота
Приклад
rows: I never go to bed late.

theory.title: Kate and Andriy talk about habits

lines.text: Do you always get up early, Andriy?
Yes, I always get up at seven o'clock. I usually have breakfast at half past seven.
I often get up late! I sometimes have breakfast at nine o'clock.
Do you always do your homework in the morning?
No, I never do my homework in the morning. I usually do it in the evening.
I often do my homework in the morning, but I sometimes do it after lunch.

theory.text: Не став always/never в кінці речення, як в українській («я встаю завжди о сьомій»). В англійській — перед дієсловом: I always get up... (не I get up always).

exercises.text: I {always} brush my teeth in the morning. I {usually} have breakfast at eight o'clock. I {never} go to bed after ten o'clock.
exercises.hint: Подумай, наскільки часто це буває: 100%, зазвичай чи 0%.

exercises.q: Прочитай діалог ще раз. Так чи ні?

items.text: Andriy: "I always get up at seven o'clock."
Andriy: "I never do my homework in the morning."
Kate: "I usually do my homework in the evening."

exercises.text: I always get up at seven o'clock. I usually have breakfast at home. I never go to bed late.

homework.text: I {usually} get up at seven o'clock. I {sometimes} watch TV in the evening. I {never} eat breakfast at school.

homework.q: Де стоїть always у реченні «I always get up at seven»?
homework.explain: Прислівники частотності стоять перед основним дієсловом.

homework.q: Напиши 4-5 речень про те, як часто ти щось робиш (always/usually/often/sometimes/never).
homework.sample: I always brush my teeth in the morning. I usually have breakfast at eight o'clock. I often play football after school. I sometimes watch cartoons in the evening. I never go to bed after ten o'clock.

homework.text: I always get up early. I often play with my friends. I never go to bed late.

reflection: Що ти робиш завжди, а що — тільки іноді?
